Slop Expenses · Beta

Expenses and receipts

Receipts and bills, posted to the ledger. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Nothing to install: just open it in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer. It keeps working without internet after your first visit. Want an icon on your home screen? On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen. On a computer, click the install icon in the address bar.

Slop Expenses has these main features: Supplier, category and the tax to reclaim; Posted to the ledger as you record it.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with Slop Expenses

  • Track business expenses
  • Log mileage and work out the claim
  • Scan a receipt into an expense
  • Keep track of bills to pay
  • A free Expensify alternative, in your browser
